reviews.text: My client had a major issue with algae & cloudiness in his pool and we tried seemingly everything to get it clear.  We worked on it for weeks.  Called My Pool Guy and they had the water crystal clear in 2 days.  Thank you so much!!!
reviews.author: CLAY STAPP CO

reviews.text: I was a Certified Pool Operator for 10 years and have worked in the Swimming industry for 30+ years. My schedule does not permit me to always take care of my own backyard pool. Tim Mott / My Pool Guy is the only business I trust to handle any issues that may arise. Tim’s staff is very well trained and the prices are very reasonable. The communication is excellent and their payment system is very easy.
reviews.author: Brandon Jones

reviews.text: My pool pump was hardly working and Tim came the same day on his way home and tightened the connections and it seemed to work better. The next day it stopped working and was very hot. That afternoon he again came by on his way home and replaced the pump. Variable speed unit is working fine and the pool is running like a new one!
reviews.author: Howard Hess

reviews.text:
I do not recommend My Pool Guy (owned by Timothy). While the staff, including Krystal and the technicians, were polite, my overall experience was very disappointing due to poor communication and incomplete service.

I initially contacted the company for a leak detection service and provided detailed information about my pool, including that the main drain might be capped and would need to be uncapped before performing a full leak detection. Despite communicating this clearly to both Krystal and the technician (Erich), the service was performed without removing the drain caps. I was later informed that the main drain was not capped and that the leak detection was completed and the leak might be at the backwash valve, which was subsequently replaced.

When I inspected the pool afterwards, I discovered that the main drain caps were still in place, confirming that a full leak detection had not been completed as promised. After notifying Krystal, I received an invoice for an additional $600 to remove the drain caps and complete the leak detection. I was also told that if the work took less time than estimated, I would receive a refund. After the technician made me aware that it took less time to please notify the office, yet a refund was only issued after I followed up with Krystal.

Once the leak detection was actually completed, I was told the main drain plumbing was likely closed off near the skimmer. To continue diagnosing the issue, I was quoted an additional $1,800 for further diagnostics and this did not include the cost for repairs, restoration of the deck or skimmer replacement. When I asked for a worst-case estimate for a full repair, I was told they could not provide one and “we will have to do this one step at a time.”

At that point, I decided not to continue with their services as I had lost confidence in their process(that took a month and a half) and communication. To make matters worse, after accessing the main drain, the technician failed to reseal it because he did not have the correct plug on hand, requiring another visit to fix the issue.

In summary, while My Pool Guy was courteous, the company failed to provide complete or transparent service. Clients who are not familiar with pool systems may not realize when work is incomplete or overbilled. My experience required constant follow-up to ensure tasks were done correctly and to secure appropriate refunds.
reviews.author: Lijo John

reviews.text: My Pool Guy has done work for us a couple of times and I would highly recommend. The first time the tech diagnosed the problem right away and did the work quickly for what I thought was an very fair price.  The  second time was when a head unit (computer) on the pump went out. They took it upon themselves to get in touch with the rep since the pump was only a couple years old and ended up getting a warranty replacement. I didn't ask him to do that and it shows me that he has integrity and treats people how he would want to be treated. I appreciate the superior knowledge and the focus on keeping prices fair. Great company, thanks!
reviews.author: Eric Vandervest

reviews.text: Tim and Kris and the staff at My Pool Guy have been wonderful. They also come out and do a great job cleaning and servicing my pool. They communicate all issues and schedule changes in a timely fashion and even send photos to me of the clean pool. I would highly recommend using them for all your pool maintenance needs.
reviews.author: Scott Harper

reviews.text:
Tim and his team did a great job on the resurfacing and modifications to our pool and tile.  We use them all year round for the weekly cleaning and maintenance and they have been excellent.
We are extremely pleased and happy with them!!!
reviews.author: Drew Harakal

reviews.text: This season’s been tough.  Had a pool leak, a cleaner pump die, and then the main pump die.  Three times Tim and his crew came out to fix my problems.  Each time has been a great experience.  The leak detection was thorough. Repair was fast.  Pump replacements were fast and well done.  Service was super fast and very personable.
reviews.author: James Willingham

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The high volume of detailed, specific 5-star reviews from varied customers indicates a quality contractor. The single detailed negative review adds credibility by showing a real customer service failure, which is addressed professionally in the owner's response. No patterns of fake reviews detected.
authentic_signals: Highly specific project details (algae, pump replacement, leak detection)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (business client, industry professional, homeowner)
Mix of glowing praise and detailed critical feedback
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google (4.9) and Yelp (4.7), indicating a stable, positive reputation. No BBB profile found is not a red flag for a smaller LLC.
